modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On December 5, 1964: Lloyd J. Old discovers the first linkage between the major histocompatibility complex (MHC) and disease—mouse leukemia—opening the way for the recognition of the importance of the MHC in the immune response.
On December 5, 1945: Flight 19, a group of TBF Avengers, disappears in the Bermuda Triangle.

did_you_know.fact: On December 5, 2014: Exploration Flight Test-1, the first flight test of Orion, is launched.
On December 5, 2005: The Civil Partnership Act comes into effect in the United Kingdom, and the first civil partnership is registered there.
On December 5, 1991: Leonid Kravchuk is elected the first president of Ukraine.
